suggested_experiment_name: Neutron star combined constraint (crust relaxation + cooling + glitches), Scenario A
coupling_convention: 1/f_a in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: This paper derives constraints on exceptionally light QCD axions in the fa-ma (or epsilon-ma) parameter space from neutron star observations (thermal relaxation, isolated cooling, pulsar glitches). The constraints are expressed in terms of epsilon = (ma/m_a^QCD)^2 rather than a standard coupling constant, excluding roughly 5e-7 < epsilon < 0.2 for ma > 2e-9 eV. Constraint tables give epsilon ranges for fixed ma >= 1e-8 eV (e.g. Table V: 5.2e-7 to 0.068 for Scenario A), but the actual exclusion boundary in the fa-ma plane appears only in figures (Figs. 14, 16, 17) that are not numerically tabulated in the provided text. Because the result is on the epsilon-ma / fa-ma plane and no coupling-vs-mass numeric pairs are extractable, no reliable data_points can be emitted.
